meta.what: the agent's executable OPERATIONS (BUILT; kept apart from the GIVEN library for the ablation). Perception readings are in readings.json, not here. `realises` names the grammar operator or NSM prime an operation executes, joining grammar.json to its code.
meta.superseded_by_metaprogramming: negate/both/either are the executable forms of ¬ + ∥; under the one bind(bond, l, r) they are what a junction calls, not separate vocabulary. all/any are degenerate (byte-identical, no scope) and are superseded by all_of/some_of once shown to reproduce their bindings.
